## Problem and result

What problem does this change solve, and what will users see afterward?

## Changes

Summarize the focused change. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. State anything you could not verify.
For visible changes, include before/after screenshots using synthetic or redacted data.

## Review notes

- [ ] Documentation uses the current control names and its links work, where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials or unrelated private tracker data are included.
- [ ] The change preserves user-triggered actions and the project’s no-background-network behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] For behavior changes, I explained the source change or coordinated with the maintainer rather than only hand-editing the generated release artifact.
